_readme: Rule: no number without a source. null = unknown (app shows 'no data' and lowers confidence). 'sources' lists keys from sources.json. 'assumed' lists fields that rest on team_assumption only. Dates are MM-DD. root_depth_m is a [min, max] range from FAO-56 Table 22; use min for irrigation-scheduling style estimates and max for rainfed stress modelling.

corn.label: Grain corn
corn.kc_basis: FAO-56 Table 12, 'Maize, Field (grain)'. kc.ini not yet read (table image). kc.end is a range depending on grain dry-down.
corn.stage_days_basis: FAO-56 Table 11, Maize (grain), Idaho USA (April planting, 170 days): cold-climate analogue for Ontario. Order: initial, development, mid, late.

soybean.label: Soybean
soybean.kc_basis: FAO-56 Table 12, 'Soybeans'. kc.ini not yet read (table image).
soybean.stage_days_basis: FAO-56 Table 11, Soybeans, Central USA (May planting, 140 days). Table prints development as '30/35'; 35 matches the 140-day total.

winter_wheat.label: Winter wheat
winter_wheat.kc_basis: FAO-56 Table 12, 'Winter Wheat' for frozen soils (ini 0.4; non-frozen soils would be 0.7). Ontario soils freeze, so the frozen-soil value is used.
winter_wheat.stage_days_basis: FAO-56 Table 11, Winter Wheat, Idaho USA (October planting, 335 days): includes the winter dormant period.

red_clover.label: Red clover (underseeded)
red_clover.kc_basis: PROXY: FAO-56 Table 12, 'Clover hay, Berseem, averaged cutting effects'. Berseem is not red clover; treat as an approximation.
red_clover.stage_days_basis: FAO-56 Table 11 has no clover rows. Underseeded clover follows the nurse crop's calendar, so use cover_calendar once defined.

cereal_rye.label: Cereal rye (cover crop)
cereal_rye.kc_basis: FAO-56 has no cereal rye entry. The only rye entry is 'Rye Grass hay' (Kc 0.95 / 1.05 / 1.00), a forage grass and not a cereal, so it is deliberately not used. Needs another source or a cover-crop study.
